The '''Moralan''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moralan]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. They were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species but freed themselves and formed a [[Moralan republic|republic]] with encouragement from the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]]. The Hutts later [[Invasion of Moralan|reconquered]] the republic and drove the Moralan to [[Death/Legends|extinction]] during the [[Xim Wars]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Moralan were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Society and culture==
For some [[Time/Legends|time]], the Moralan served as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species, who controlled [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], where the [[Moralan]] homeworld was located. After they freed themselves from slavery with encouragement from the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]],<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> the Moralan established an independent [[Moralan republic|republic]],<ref name="Atlas" /> which was controlled by a body known as the [[Parliament of Moralan]].<ref name="Droids">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref>

==History==
The Moralan were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Moralan,<ref name="Atlas" /> located in the [[Moralan system/Legends|Moralan system]].<ref name="Xim" /> The species' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] fell within the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as Hutt Space as early as [[25,127 BBY]], and they were enslaved by the Hutts who controlled that region.<ref name="Atlas" /> The Moralan freed themselves and threw off their overlords with encouragement from the Tionese, foes of the Hutts who moved forces into the Moralan [[Star system/Legends|system]] during the [[Xim Wars]],<ref name="Xim" /> fought between [[25,102 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas" />

The Moralan founded an independent republic<ref name="Atlas" /> led by a body known as the Parliament of Moralan.<ref name="Droids" /> However, once the Tionese withdrew their forces from the system after the [[Second Battle of Vontor]],<ref name="Xim" /> a Hutt named [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu]] conquered the Moralan republic in a three-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Invasion of Moralan|battle]].<ref name="Droids" /> Boonta then drove the species [[Death/Legends|extinct]] by sterilizing the planet Moralan<ref name="Xim" /> as a lesson to other slave species who might consider rebellion.<ref name="EGtw">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Boonta's victory against the Moralan was later celebrated with a holiday named after him&mdash;[[Boonta Eve/Legends|Boonta's Eve]], which lasted three days, just as the battle had.<ref name="Droids" />

A [[Unidentified dealer (Jabba)|dealer]] who sold an [[Ayalayli thornwood/Legends|Ayalayli thornwood]]-framed [[Gong/Legends|gong]] to the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] swore that it had been used by the Parliament of Moralan prior to the extinction of the Moralan species. The gong became one of the criminal's favorite conversation pieces and he used it to signal the start of the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TPMVDE">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NERC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Moralan were first mentioned indirectly as a parliament in an article by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] on the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] TV series in [[Polyhedron 170|issue 170]] of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] magazine, which was released in [[June]] [[2004]].<ref name="Droids" /> They were then named as a species in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Atlas" />
